mapper.insert: INSERT INTO export_template (customer_id, template_type, name, storage_path, column_mapping, sheet_config, is_active, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{customerId}, #{templateType}, #{name}, #{storagePath}, #{columnMapping}, #{sheetConfig}, #{isActive}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM export_template WHERE customer_id IS NULL AND template_type = #{templateType} AND is_active = 1 ORDER BY id ASC
